<noinclude>
This is the "Equipment" form. To create a page with this form, enter the page name below;
if a page with that name already exists, you will be editing that page.

{{#forminput:form=Equipment|size=50|button text=Create or edit equipment}}
</noinclude>
<includeonly>
{{{for template|Equipment}}}
{{{field|name|mandatory|label=Equipment Name|input type=text|size=50}}}
{{{field|type|mandatory|label=Equipment Type|input type=dropdown|values=Microscope,Centrifuge,Incubator,Autoclave,Spectrophotometer,Other}}}
{{{field|manufacturer|label=Manufacturer|input type=text|size=50}}}
{{{field|model|label=Model|input type=text|size=50}}}
{{{field|serial_number|label=Serial Number|input type=text|size=50}}}
{{{field|location|mandatory|label=Location|input type=text|size=50|hint=Room number or location}}}
{{{field|status|mandatory|label=Status|input type=dropdown|values=Active,Inactive,Archived|default=Active}}}
{{{field|owner|label=Owner|input type=combobox|values from category=Personnel|autocomplete on property=Personnel Role}}}
{{{field|purchase_date|label=Purchase Date|input type=date|mandatory}}
{{{field|cost|label=Cost ($)|input type=number|size=20|hint=Purchase cost in dollars}}}
{{{field|last_maintenance|label=Last Maintenance Date|input type=date}}}
{{{field|next_calibration|label=Next Calibration Date|input type=date}}}
{{{standard input|free text|rows=10|label=Additional Notes}}}
{{{standard input|summary}}}
{{{standard input|save}}}
{{{standard input|preview}}}
{{{standard input|changes}}}
{{{standard input|cancel}}}
</includeonly>
